description: Fairford Road Catchment Flood Study Report is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canterbury-Bankstown Council. Study Area The study area is located in south west Sydney at the northern end of the suburbs of Revesby and Padstow. It is an urban catchment that drains in an easterly direction through a stormwater pipe and open channel network to Salt Pan Creek, a tributary of the Georges River. Coverage: Canterbury-Bankstown Council. The portal files it under the publisher Canterbury-Bankstown Council. Its tags are Fairford Road Catchment, Padstow, Revesby, Salt Pan Creek, hydrologic model. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-03-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
